result.summary: Mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` and removes redundant `<cassert>` includes across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files that use assertions. It also updates CI lint scripts to allow `clang-format` inside scripted-diff verification scripts and resorts the modified includes.
result.problem: Test code frequently relies on transitive includes or standard `<cassert>` for assertions, causing ambiguity over whether `NDEBUG` can disable assertions. Furthermore, direct includes are missing for `Assert`/`assert`, which impedes Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling and causes compilation failures when assertions in `util/check.h` are disabled.
evidence: PR description: 'In test code, `assert` is used. This is perfectly fine, but sometimes confusion arises, when it is unclear whether `NDEBUG` can disable the assertions, or whether to use `assert` or `Assert`.'
Commit fab3a5e3cd: 'The project has a compile error when compiled without assertions in util/check.h. Thus, util/check.h should be included for all assertions.'
result.scope_notes: Large scripted-diff affecting 154 files across tests, fuzz harnesses, and benchmarks, along with a small modification to `ci/lint/01_install.sh` to allow running clang-format inside scripted-diff verify steps.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased without changes to the underlying approach or commit structure.
result.card: This PR uses a scripted diff to add explicit `#include <util/check.h>` and remove `<cassert>` across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files using assertions. It eliminates ambiguity over whether `NDEBUG` can disable assertions in tests, prevents compile failures when assertions in `util/check.h` are disabled, and facilitates Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling. It also modifies CI lint scripts to allow clang-format inside scripted-diff verification steps.

risk.why: Touches only test code headers and CI lint installation scripts.
